import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths as given
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_4.csv"
    ]

    # Columns of the target schema
    target_columns = ['GEO.id', 'GEO.id2', 'GEO.display-label', 'HD01_VD01', 'HD02_VD01', 'Year']

    # Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0, dtype=str)  # read all as string first to avoid conversion errors
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION) since all have the same schema
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Clean and convert columns to match target schema types:
    # Target schema types:
    # 'GEO.id': string
    # 'GEO.id2': string (note: source has float sometimes, convert to string without decimal)
    # 'GEO.display-label': string
    # 'HD01_VD01': string (source sometimes numeric but target example shows string with leading zeros)
    # 'HD02_VD01': string (target example shows float values, but schema says string, so convert to string)
    # 'Year': integer

    # 1) GEO.id: already string, keep as is
    combined_df['GEO.id'] = combined_df['GEO.id'].astype(str)

    # 2) GEO.id2: convert to string without decimal point (remove trailing .0 if present)
    # Some values are float-like strings, e.g. '29329.0', convert to int then string
    def clean_geo_id2(val):
        try:
            f = float(val)
            i = int(f)
            return str(i)
        except:
            return str(val).strip()
    combined_df['GEO.id2'] = combined_df['GEO.id2'].apply(clean_geo_id2)

    # 3) GEO.display-label: string, keep as is
    combined_df['GEO.display-label'] = combined_df['GEO.display-label'].astype(str)

    # 4) HD01_VD01: target examples show strings with leading zeros (e.g. '00979')
    # Source sometimes numeric or string without leading zeros.
    # We will convert to int then format as zero-padded 5-digit string (based on examples)
    def format_hd01(val):
        try:
            # Some values may be float-like strings, convert to int first
            f = float(val)
            i = int(f)
            return f"{i:05d}"
        except:
            # fallback: just return as string stripped
            return str(val).strip()
    combined_df['HD01_VD01'] = combined_df['HD01_VD01'].apply(format_hd01)

    # 5) HD02_VD01: target schema says string, but target examples show float values as strings (e.g. '12.0')
    # We will convert to float then back to string with one decimal place
    def format_hd02(val):
        try:
            f = float(val)
            # Format with one decimal place, remove trailing .0 if integer
            if f.is_integer():
                return str(int(f))
            else:
                return f"{f:.1f}"
        except:
            return str(val).strip()
    combined_df['HD02_VD01'] = combined_df['HD02_VD01'].apply(format_hd02)

    # 6) Year: integer
    # Some source values might be float-like strings, convert safely to int
    def format_year(val):
        try:
            f = float(val)
            i = int(f)
            return i
        except:
            # If conversion fails, fallback to NaN (will drop later)
            return pd.NA
    combined_df['Year'] = combined_df['Year'].apply(format_year)

    # Drop rows with missing Year (if any)
    combined_df = combined_df.dropna(subset=['Year'])

    # Convert Year column dtype to int
    combined_df['Year'] = combined_df['Year'].astype(int)

    # Reorder columns to target schema order (just in case)
    combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

    # Write the combined and transformed DataFrame to the target CSV file
    combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_70/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Concatenate all source tables (UNION)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes and column names as per target schema
# Convert GEO.id2 to string (some sources have float, some int)
df['GEO.id2'] = df['GEO.id2'].astype(str)

# Convert Year to int (some sources have float)

# Convert HD01_VD01 and HD02_VD01 to string as in target schema

df['HD02_VD01'] = df['HD02_VD01'].astype(float)

# Convert HD02_VD01 back to string to match target schema
